subject: Quick Follow-Up – Encord Overview & Use Cases
text:
Hey Kyle, 

 Great to hear from you! And thank you for forwarding the all the info.

 Hey Shannon, Eoin, 

 Kyle, cc´d, is an old friend of mine and reached out to introduce me to Encord. See below and attached. 

 Let me know how´s best to investigate further (who in Evercam should be looped in).

 Thanks,

 Darah Callan 

Senior Customer Success Manager | +353 871 915 529 

EVERCAM - Construction Visibility  

 www.evercam.io

 ---- On Fri, 11 Apr 2025 15:01:38 +0200 
 Kyle McCarthy <kyle.mccarthy@encord.ai> wrote ---

Hey Darah,

Great chatting yesterday. Before joining Encord, I was part of the venture capital team at Salesforce, so I’m familiar with Evercam and the wider Elkstone portfolio - always great to see an Irish company doing well.

Wanted to share a bit more about Encord that might be of interest. I’ve attached some slides with a more detailed overview, but here are a few highlights I thought could be particularly relevant:

• 

We’ve built an end-to-end data development platform for computer vision teams - bringing together data curation, annotation, workflow management, and model observability in one place.

• 

Our platform is video-native, enabling a level of granularity and speed that open-source tools often struggle with.

• 

We’re working with sophisticated AI/ML teams like OnsiteIQ and CONXAI (case study here).

If you or anyone on the Evercam team is keen to learn more about Encord, I’d be happy to chat.

Cheers,
 Kyle
